$comment: Traces: one object per photograph, newest first. Only 'id', 'src', 'width', 'height' and 'alt' are required.

photos.alt: A thin crescent moon against black sky, craters sharp along the terminator.
photos.caption: Crescent, from the terrace

photos.alt: A video of a gibbous moon hanging in black sky, its craters and grey maria sharp along the terminator.
photos.caption: Gibbous, in motion

photos.alt: The sun through a solar filter, glowing orange-red, with a small group of dark sunspots near the centre.
photos.caption: The sun, and its spots

photos.alt: A bright, nearly full moon filling the frame, its grey maria and rayed craters clear.
photos.caption: Full moon

photos.alt: The Orion Nebula: a glowing cloud of gas around a bright core, scattered with stars.
photos.caption: M42, the Orion Nebula

photos.alt: A warm, honey-toned gibbous moon with deep craters along its shadowed edge.
photos.caption: Gibbous, low and warm

photos.alt: A video of a huge orange setting sun, with the silhouette of a tree's branches drifting across its edge.
photos.caption: The sun, through the trees

photos.alt: The same half moon twice: once cool and silver, once warm and golden.
photos.caption: One moon, two temperatures

photos.alt: A close crop of the sun's orange disc, sunspots scattered across its face.
photos.caption: Sunspots on the limb

photos.alt: A slim crescent moon on black, with the words Cosmic Voyagerzz above it.
photos.caption: Cosmic Voyagerzz

photos.alt: Saturn as a small, soft golden disc with its rings tilted across it.
photos.caption: Saturn, rings and all

photos.alt: A video montage: moon photographs signed Cosmic Voyagerzz, then NASA Artemis replying: Always great to see the craters in such detail. Thanks for sharing your #NASAMoonSnap with us!
photos.caption: #NASAMoonSnap, and a reply from NASA Artemis

photos.alt: A crescent moon, lit from the left, craters crowding the shadow line.
photos.caption: Crescent

photos.alt: The whole sun as a deep orange disc on black, with a single tiny sunspot.
photos.caption: The whole sun

photos.alt: A pale waning gibbous moon, its bright rim and shadowed craters in soft grey.
photos.caption: Waning gibbous

photos.alt: The moon partly dimmed, its lower edge fading into shadow.
photos.caption: A moon in shadow

photos.alt: A faint green smudge among stars in the round field of a telescope eyepiece.
photos.caption: A green visitor

photos.alt: A sharp crescent moon, the lunar highlands bright against a black sky.
photos.caption: Crescent, sharper
